Little Computer

A tribute to the small game-console character from Adventure Time: dark features on a pale mint screen, round wide-set eyes and a tiny mouth. The one set that inverts the palette — everything else is light on black, and this is black on light, which is the whole reason it reads as a different machine rather than a recolour.
